name: MultiFAB Convexification and Parallel Volume Rendering
definition: A parallel volume rendering strategy for AMR meshes where MultiFABs are processed independently by a GPU renderer (Viskores) and results are combined via MPI reduction.
summary: MultiFAB Convexification and Parallel Volume Rendering is a parallel strategy for AMR meshes that preprocesses data to handle non-convexities and dependency loops, enabling correct independent GPU rendering and MPI merging.
